triage.kind_span: Barings BDC and Sierra are proposing a combination of both companies by a merger and related transactions pursuant to the Merger Agreement

subject_names.value: Barings BDC, Inc.; Sierra Income Corporation
subject_names.span: of Barings BDC, Inc., a Maryland corporation (“Barings BDC”), under Section 5 of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), with respect to the shares of Barings BDC common stock, $0.001 par value per share (“Barings BDC Common Stock”), to be issued to the holders of shares of common stock, par value $0.001 per share (“Sierra Common Stock”), of Sierra Income Corporation

subject_tickers.span: Barings BDC Common Stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) under the ticker symbol “BBDC.”

security_class.span: each share of Sierra common stock, $0.001 par value per share (“Sierra Common Stock”), issued and outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the First Merger

acquirer.span: Immediately after the effectiveness of the First Merger, Sierra, as the surviving corporation, will merge with and into Barings BDC (together with the First Merger, the “Merger”), with Barings BDC continuing as the surviving corporation.

targets.span: Mercury Acquisition Sub, Inc., a Maryland corporation and a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of Barings BDC (“Acquisition Sub”), Sierra Income Corporation, a Maryland corporation (“Sierra”)

n_targets.span: Barings BDC and Sierra are proposing a combination of both companies by a merger and related transactions pursuant to the Merger Agreement

exchange_basis.span: will be converted into the right to receive (i) $0.9783641 per share in cash, without interest, from Barings (such amount of cash, the “Cash Consideration”), and (ii) 0.44973 (the “Exchange Ratio”) of a validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable share of Barings BDC Common Stock

exchange_ratio.span: The Exchange Ratio was fixed at the signing of the Merger Agreement at 0.44973.

cash_per_share.span: (i) $0.9783641 per share in cash, without interest, from Barings (such amount of cash, the “Cash Consideration”)

collar.span: Because the Exchange Ratio is fixed, other than customary anti-dilution adjustments in the event of certain changes in the number of outstanding shares of Barings BDC Common Stock and Sierra Common Stock, the value of the consideration to be received by Sierra stockholders in the First Merger will depend on the market price of shares of Barings BDC Common Stock at the time of the First Merger.

spans: The Merger Stock Issuance Proposal and the Barings BDC Below NAV Proposals with respect to Barings BDC, and the Merger Proposal with respect to Sierra, are conditions precedent to the closing of the Merger.
Sierra’s obligation to effect the Merger is conditioned on its receipt of an opinion from Sullivan & Worcester LLP (“S&W”)

expected_close.span: Barings BDC and Sierra are working to complete the Merger in the first quarter of 2022.

termination_date.span: Except in specified circumstances, if the Merger is not completed by March 31, 2022, either Sierra or Barings BDC may choose not to proceed with the Merger.

notes: Preliminary N-14 8C joint proxy statement/prospectus (dated October 29, 2021) for the two-step merger of Sierra Income Corporation into Barings BDC, Inc. (via Mercury Acquisition Sub, Inc.). Consideration per Sierra share: $0.9783641 cash paid by Barings LLC (the adviser, not the BDC) plus 0.44973 BBDC shares (fixed ratio, customary anti-dilution adjustments only). Collar=false is read from the statement that the ratio is fixed and the consideration's value depends on the BBDC market price; the filing does not use the word collar. Conditions: only stockholder approvals and the S&W tax opinion are stated as conditions within the excerpt; the full closing-conditions section (Description of the Merger Agreement, p.89) is after the cut, so other categories may exist. HSR filing fees are mentioned but HSR clearance is not stated as a condition in the excerpt. Meeting dates and record dates are blank placeholders ([•], 2022 / [•], 2021), so null. Sierra Common Stock has no secondary market; only BBDC is listed. Termination date is the March 31, 2022 date after which either party may choose not to proceed, 'except in specified circumstances'. Sierra may owe an $11.0 million termination fee and up to $2.0 million expense reimbursement (not schema fields). Acquirer value uses the full legal name; the span uses the defined short name 'Barings BDC'.
